profile.bio: a software engineer and product builder from Indonesia. I build useful applications for everyday needs. My strong suite is Flutter application design and Native Database control.
profile.about: I'm making apps that I would actually use instead of making apps that are boring and too complicated. Currently I am making UNMURCE, an expense tracker tuned for lazy young adults. Every month I have to get my dad to reimburse my expenses, so I made an app that automatically saves my expenses, categorizes, sorts and views them as charts of data that could be exported into a PDF so my dad can see details.
